items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 124:1
items.html: (To the question) The Hochma and Hesed of ZA are called surrounding [lights] at the time of the slumber, namely at the time of the ascent of MAN to AVI, because they ascended there to the palace of AVI as MAN; for since ZA remains below with only VAK, and his Mochin are found in AVI, they are discerned there above as the aspect of surrounding lights (Or Makif) for his VAK. (Item 151).
